design.task_generation_basis: Broad ordinary real-world functional domains with predeclared lexical requirements and controlled-paraphrase paths.
design.scoring_law: A if all direct requirements are available; otherwise B if any frozen paraphrase path is fully available and semantically acceptable; otherwise C.
